---
name: I use this
about: Tell us how you use zkagent-attest, and what breaks
title: "[I use this] "
labels: usage
---

**What are you attesting?** (a coding session, a spend-capped agent, an audit trail)

**Which binary and version?** (`zkagent version` output: semver, format, commit)

**What did the verdict say?** (`zkagent_attest` result; paste the JSON, not a summary)

**What went wrong, if anything?** A refusal is useful too: tell us which cap you asked for
and what the session actually totalled.

**Anything you had to configure?** Cost table changes, `ZKAGENT_BIN`, policy TTL.
